cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
cards.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still leading tomorrow's training. You called their head trainer an idiot; I need you to apologize for undermining that position.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry the drill went badly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not the drill, the head trainer. Put it in your own words; I want the trainees and us working together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll email them tonight. I won't stand up and give a speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An email is fine. Send it before the drill and let me read the apology aloud at the start. I'll use your wording. My first instruction needs to sound like it comes from their trainer again.

reason: Accept B email format and own wording while preserving the need for a role-restoring apology to reach trainees before the next instructions.
